## The Task
M8 Tasks 5+6 (system MCP / global Agent admin). Briefs if needed: `.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-11-m8-admin-console/task-5-brief.md`, `task-6-brief.md`.

## The Findings Under Verification
1. **Important — 503 error code mismatch**: sensitive headers with no `CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY` must return 503 `secret_store_unavailable`; the shared `app/core/ssrf.py` raised `ServiceUnavailableError` without a code → `service_unavailable`. Fix: add `code="secret_store_unavailable"` in ssrf.py; add admin MCP test (monkeypatch empty key, POST/PATCH sensitive header, assert 503 + code). HTTP status stays 503; only code changes (shared helper also affects user-side paths).
2. **Minor — 404 edge tests**: PATCH/DELETE user-owned MCP → 404; random UUID → 404; admin list excludes user-owned MCP; T6 soft-deleted agent PATCH → 404.
3. **Minor — blank name**: MCP `update_system_server` and Agent `admin_update_agent` must reject whitespace-only `name` with 422.

## The Fix

Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

计划/brief 要求敏感头明文且无 `CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY` 时返回 503 `secret_store_unavailable`，但
`app/core/ssrf.py::normalize_headers` 抛出的 `ServiceUnavailableError` 未传 `code`，实际 code 为

`app/core/ssrf.py` 的 `normalize_headers` 在加密不可用时补 `code="secret_store_unavailable"`：

44: def is_private_host(hostname: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:

52:     try:
53:         info = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None, proto=socket.IPPROTO_TCP)
54:     except OSError as exc:

67:         if str(ip) in _METADATA_IPS or str(ip).startswith("fd00:ec2::"):
68:             return True, f"禁止访问云元数据地址：{raw_ip}"

165:     key = get_settings().capability_secret_key.strip()
166:     if key:
167:         # 用 sha256 把任意长度配置密钥归一成 32 字节 AES-GCM 密钥。

172: def encrypt_secret(plaintext: str) -> str | None:
173:     """加密敏感值；返回 ``v1:<base64(nonce+ciphertext)>`` 或 ``None``（无密钥）。"""
174:     key = _secret_key_bytes()
175:     if not key:
176:         return None
177:     nonce = os.urandom(12)
178:     ciphertext = AESGCM(key).encrypt(nonce, plaintext.encode(), None)
179:     return "v1:" + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(nonce + ciphertext).decode()

182: def decrypt_secret(token: str) -> str | None:
183:     """解密敏感值；密文格式非法或密钥缺失返回 ``None``。"""
184:     if not token.startswith("v1:"):
185:         return None
186:     key = _secret_key_bytes()
187:     if not key:
188:         return None
189:     try:
190:         raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token[3:])
191:         return AESGCM(key).decrypt(raw[:12], raw[12:], None).decode()
192:     except Exception:
193:         logger.warning("凭据密文解密失败（密钥轮换？）")
194:         return None

197: def normalize_headers(
198:     raw: dict[str, str], *, allow_platform_secret: bool = False
199: ) -> tuple[dict[str, object], str]:
200:     """把用户提交的请求头转成可落库的形态。
201: 
202:     - 普通头：明文存储；
203:     - 敏感头且值为 ``env:NAME``：存 ``{"secret_ref": "env:NAME"}``；
204:     - 敏感头值为 ``secret:NAME``：仅管理员（``allow_platform_secret``）可用，
205:       引用 ``platform_secrets``，运行时解析；
206:     - 敏感头明文：有 CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY 时 AES-GCM 加密存储，否则 503。
207:     返回 ``(存储形态, credentials_hint)``。
208:     """
209:     stored: dict[str, object] = {}
210:     hints: list[str] = []
211:     for name, value in raw.items():
212:         value = (value or "").strip()
213:         if not value:
214:             continue
215:         if name.strip().lower() in _SECRET_HEADER_NAMES:
216:             if _SECRET_REF_PATTERN.match(value):
217:                 stored[name] = {"secret_ref": value}
218:                 hints.append(f"{name}: {value}")
219:             elif value.startswith("secret:"):
220:                 if not allow_platform_secret:
221:                     raise ValidationFailedError(
222:                         "secret: 引用仅管理员可配置", code="secret_ref_not_allowed"
223:                     )
224:                 if not _PLATFORM_SECRET_REF_PATTERN.match(value):
225:                     raise ValidationFailedError(
226:                         "secret_ref 必须为 secret:密钥名 形式", code="secret_ref_invalid"
227:                     )
228:                 stored[name] = {"secret_ref": value}
229:                 hints.append(f"{name}: {value}")
230:             else:
231:                 ciphertext = encrypt_secret(value)
232:                 if ciphertext is None:
233:                     raise ServiceUnavailableError(
234:                         "保存凭据需要配置 CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY，或改用 env:环境变量名 引用",
235:                         code="secret_store_unavailable",
236:                     )
237:                 stored[name] = {"ciphertext": ciphertext}
238:                 hints.append(f"{name}: ****{value[-4:]}")
239:         else:
240:             stored[name] = value[:2000]
241:     return stored, " ".join(hints)[:160]
242:

244: def resolve_headers(stored: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, str]:
245:     """把落库形态还原成请求头；解析失败的 secret_ref 跳过（不发错误头）。"""
246:     resolved: dict[str, str] = {}
247:     for name, value in stored.items():
248:         if isinstance(value, str):
249:             resolved[name] = value
250:             continue
251:         if not isinstance(value, dict):
252:             continue
253:         ref = value.get("secret_ref")
254:         if isinstance(ref, str) and ref.startswith("env:"):
255:             env_value = os.environ.get(ref[4:], "")
256:             if env_value:
257:                 resolved[name] = env_value
258:             continue
259:         ciphertext = value.get("ciphertext")
260:         if isinstance(ciphertext, str):
261:             plaintext = decrypt_secret(ciphertext)
262:             if plaintext:
263:                 resolved[name] = plaintext
264:     return resolved

270:     """异步版请求头还原：``env:`` 读环境变量，``secret:`` 查平台密钥表。

def _validate_create(payload: McpServerCreateRequest, user: User) -> None:
    if payload.transport == "stdio":
        if user.role != "admin":
            raise ValidationFailedError(
                "普通用户只能创建远程 URL 的 MCP 服务器（stdio 未开放）",
                code="mcp_transport_not_allowed",
            )
        if not payload.command:
            raise ValidationFailedError("stdio 传输必须提供 command")
        allowlist = get_settings().mcp_stdio_command_allowlist
        if allowlist and payload.command.split("/")[-1] not in allowlist:
            raise ValidationFailedError(
                "stdio 命令不在白名单内", code="mcp_transport_not_allowed"
            )
        return
    if not payload.url:
        raise ValidationFailedError("远程传输必须提供 url")
    validate_mcp_url(payload.url)


async def create_server(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: McpServerCreateRequest
) -> McpServerOut:
    _require_enabled()
    _validate_create(payload, user)
    settings = get_settings()
    own_count = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count(McpServer.id)).where(
            McpServer.scope == "user", McpServer.owner_user_id == user.id
        )
    )
    if int(own_count or 0) >= settings.mcp_max_servers_per_user:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            f"每人最多创建 {settings.mcp_max_servers_per_user} 个 MCP 服务器"
        )
    system_slug = await db.scalar(
        select(McpServer.id).where(McpServer.scope == "system", McpServer.slug == payload.slug)
    )
    if system_slug is not None:
        raise ConflictError("slug 与系统服务器冲突")
    stored_headers, hint = normalize_headers(
        payload.headers, allow_platform_secret=user.role == "admin"
    )
    server = McpServer(
        scope="user",
        owner_user_id=user.id,
        slug=payload.slug,
        name=payload.name,
        description=payload.description,
        transport=payload.transport,
        url=payload.url,
        command=payload.command,
        args=list(payload.args),
        headers=stored_headers,
        credentials_hint=hint,
        enabled=True,
        auto_inject=True,
        force_disabled=False,
        health_status="unknown",
    )
    db.add(server)
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="mcp.server.create",
        resource_type="mcp_server",
        resource_id=str(server.id),
        detail={"slug": payload.slug, "transport": payload.transport, "url": payload.url},
    )
    try:
        await db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        raise ConflictError("slug 已存在") from exc
    await db.refresh(server)
    # 创建后立即做一次健康检查与工具发现；失败也保留配置（前端可修正）。
    await _check_and_sync(db, server, force=True)
    await db.refresh(server)
    return await get_server(db, user, server.id)


async def update_server(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, server_id: uuid.UUID, payload: McpServerUpdateRequest
) -> McpServerOut:
    server = await _load_visible(db, user, server_id)
    if server.scope != "user":
        raise ForbiddenError("系统 MCP 服务器不可修改")
    if payload.url is not None:
        if not payload.url:
            raise ValidationFailedError("远程传输必须提供 url")
        validate_mcp_url(payload.url)
        server.url = payload.url
    if payload.name is not None:
        server.name = payload.name.strip()
    if payload.description is not None:
        server.description = payload.description.strip()
    if payload.auto_inject is not None:
        server.auto_inject = payload.auto_inject
    if payload.headers is not None:
        stored_headers, hint = normalize_headers(
            payload.headers, allow_platform_secret=user.role == "admin"
        )
        server.headers = stored_headers
        server.credentials_hint = hint
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="mcp.server.update",
        resource_type="mcp_server",
        resource_id=str(server_id),
    )
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(server)
    await _check_and_sync(db, server, force=True)
    await db.refresh(server)
    return await get_server(db, user, server.id)


async def delete_server(db: AsyncSession, user: User, server_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    server = await _load_visible(db, user, server_id)
    if server.scope != "user":
        raise ForbiddenError("系统 MCP 服务器不可删除")
    await db.delete(server)
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="mcp.server.delete",
        resource_type="mcp_server",
        resource_id=str(server_id),
        detail={"slug": server.slug},
    )
    await db.commit()


async def create_system_server(
    db: AsyncSession, admin: User, payload: McpServerCreateRequest
) -> McpServerOut:
    """创建系统 MCP：进入所有用户工具目录，slug 必须全局唯一。

    复用用户侧 ``_validate_create``（stdio 仅管理员、URL SSRF、command 必填）与
    ``normalize_headers(allow_platform_secret=True)``；不检查每人配额。提交后立即
    做一次工具发现（不可达仍 201，状态写 unhealthy）。
    """
    _validate_create(payload, admin)
    existing = await db.scalar(
        select(McpServer.id).where(McpServer.slug == payload.slug)
    )
    if existing is not None:
        raise ConflictError("slug 已被其他 MCP 服务器占用")
    stored_headers, hint = normalize_headers(
        payload.headers, allow_platform_secret=True

    server = McpServer(
        scope="system",
        owner_user_id=None,
        slug=payload.slug,
        name=payload.name,
        description=payload.description,
        transport=payload.transport,
        url=payload.url,
        command=payload.command,
        args=list(payload.args),
        headers=stored_headers,
        credentials_hint=hint,
        enabled=True,
        auto_inject=True,
        force_disabled=False,
        health_status="unknown",
    )
    db.add(server)
    try:
        await db.flush()
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        raise ConflictError("slug 已存在") from exc
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(admin.id),
        action="mcp.server.create",
        resource_type="mcp_server",
        resource_id=str(server.id),
        detail={
            "slug": payload.slug,
            "transport": payload.transport,
            "url": payload.url,
            "scope": "system",
        },
    )
    try:
        await db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        raise ConflictError("slug 已存在") from exc
    await db.refresh(server)
    await _check_and_sync(db, server, force=True)
    await db.refresh(server)
    return await _system_server_out(db, server)

async def delete_agent(db: AsyncSession, user: User, agent_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    agent = await _get_agent(db, agent_id)
    active = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count())
        .select_from(A2aTask)
        .where(A2aTask.remote_agent_id == agent_id, A2aTask.state.in_(A2A_ACTIVE_STATES))
    )
    if active:
        raise ConflictError("该 Agent 存在运行中的任务，无法删除", code="agent_has_active_tasks")
    agent.deleted_at = _now()
    await write_audit(
        db,
        actor_type="user",
        actor_id=str(user.id),
        action="agent.deleted",
        resource_type="agent",
        resource_id=str(agent.id),
        detail={"slug": agent.slug},
    )
    await db.commit()


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 刷新 / 健康


async def _record_health(
    db: AsyncSession, agent: RemoteAgent, *, ok: bool, latency_ms: int | None, error: str | None
) -> None:
    now = _now()
    agent.last_checked_at = now
    agent.last_latency_ms = latency_ms
    if ok:
        agent.consecutive_failures = 0
        agent.health_status = "healthy" if (latency_ms or 0) < _HEALTHY_LATENCY_MS else "degraded"
        agent.last_error = None
    else:
        agent.consecutive_failures += 1
        agent.health_status = (
            "unhealthy" if agent.consecutive_failures >= _UNHEALTHY_FAILURES else "degraded"
        )
        agent.last_error = (error or "健康检查失败")[:500]


async def refresh_agent(db: AsyncSession, user: User, agent_id: uuid.UUID) -> AgentRefreshResult:
    agent = await _get_agent(db, agent_id)
    try:
        fetched = await fetch_agent_card(agent.url, headers=await _resolved_headers(db, agent))
    except ValidationFailedError as exc:
        await _record_health(db, agent, ok=False, latency_ms=None, error=exc.message)
        await write_audit(
            db,
            actor_type="user",
            actor_id=str(user.id),
            action="agent.refresh_failed",
            resource_type="agent",
            resource_id=str(agent.id),
            detail={"error": exc.message[:200]},
        )
        await db.commit()
        raise
    normalized = fetched.normalized
    changed_fields: list[str] = []

        agent.skills = new_skills
    if agent.description != normalized["description"]:

async def _load_visible(db: AsyncSession, user: User, server_id: uuid.UUID) -> McpServer:
    _require_enabled()
    server = await db.get(McpServer, server_id)
    if server is None or (server.scope == "user" and server.owner_user_id != user.id):
        raise NotFoundError("MCP 服务器不存在")
    return server


async def _load_system_server(db: AsyncSession, server_id: uuid.UUID) -> McpServer:
    """按 id 加载系统 MCP；用户自建或不存在统一 404（不经过 ``_load_visible``）。"""
    server = await db.scalar(
        select(McpServer).where(
            McpServer.id == server_id, McpServer.scope == "system"
        )
    )
    if server is None:
        raise NotFoundError("系统 MCP 服务器不存在")
    return server


async def _system_server_out(db: AsyncSession, server: McpServer) -> McpServerOut:
    """系统 MCP 输出：``effective_enabled`` 取全局口径，不走用户覆盖。"""
    count = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count(McpTool.id)).where(McpTool.server_id == server.id)
    )
    return _server_out(
        server,
        effective=server.enabled and not server.force_disabled,
        tool_count=int(count or 0),
    )

async def test_patch_fields_force_disable_and_discovery(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, admin_auth: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    """PATCH 修改白名单字段；force_disabled 覆盖用户覆盖；改 URL 重新发现工具。"""
    _register_mock(MCP_URL, [MOCK_TOOL_READ, MOCK_TOOL_WRITE])
    _register_mock(MCP_URL_2, [MOCK_TOOL_READ])
    registered = await register_user(client)
    user_headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    server = await _create_system(client, admin_auth, slug="patch-mcp")

    # 用户先写覆盖；强制停用后覆盖失效。
    override = await client.put(
        f"{USER_URL}/{server['id']}/enabled", json={"enabled": True}, headers=user_headers
    )
    assert override.status_code == 200, override.text
    forced = await client.patch(
        f"{ADMIN_URL}/{server['id']}", json={"force_disabled": True}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert forced.status_code == 200, forced.text
    assert forced.json()["force_disabled"] is True
    assert forced.json()["effective_enabled"] is False
    assert (await _user_item(client, user_headers, server["id"]))["effective_enabled"] is False

    restored = await client.patch(
        f"{ADMIN_URL}/{server['id']}",
        json={"force_disabled": False, "enabled": True},
        headers=admin_auth,
    )
    assert restored.status_code == 200, restored.text
    assert restored.json()["effective_enabled"] is True

    edited = await client.patch(
        f"{ADMIN_URL}/{server['id']}",
        json={
            "name": "管理台改名 MCP",
            "description": "管理台描述",
            "headers": {"X-Trace": "plain"},
            "auto_inject": False,
        },
        headers=admin_auth,
    )
    assert edited.status_code == 200, edited.text
    edited_body = edited.json()
    assert edited_body["name"] == "管理台改名 MCP"
    assert edited_body["description"] == "管理台描述"
    assert edited_body["auto_inject"] is False
    assert edited_body["tool_count"] == 2

    moved = await client.patch(
        f"{ADMIN_URL}/{server['id']}", json={"url": MCP_URL_2}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert moved.status_code == 200, moved.text
    assert moved.json()["tool_count"] == 1
    assert moved.json()["health_status"] == "healthy"

    empty = await client.patch(f"{ADMIN_URL}/{server['id']}", json={}, headers=admin_auth)
    assert empty.status_code == 422, empty.text
    assert empty.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"

    blank_name = await client.patch(
        f"{ADMIN_URL}/{server['id']}", json={"name": "   "}, headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert blank_name.status_code == 422, blank_name.text
    assert blank_name.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"

    # slug/transport/command/args 不可编辑，显式 422 而不是静默忽略。
    for field, value in (
        ("slug", "renamed-slug"),
        ("transport", "sse"),
        ("command", "cat"),
        ("args", ["--x"]),
    ):
        rejected = await client.patch(
            f"{ADMIN_URL}/{server['id']}", json={field: value}, headers=admin_auth
        )
        assert rejected.status_code == 422, (field, rejected.text)
        assert rejected.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"

### 2.8 MCP

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/mcp/servers` | 系统项 + 自己创建的 MCP 服务器（含有效启停状态） |
| POST | `/api/v1/mcp/servers` | 创建（用户侧仅远程 URL，stdio 默认禁用） |
| GET | `/api/v1/mcp/servers/{id}` | 详情 |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/mcp/servers/{id}` | 修改名称/URL/凭据/自动注入 |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/mcp/servers/{id}` | 删除（系统项不可删） |
| PUT | `/api/v1/mcp/servers/{id}/enabled` | 启停（系统项写用户覆盖表） |
| POST | `/api/v1/mcp/servers/{id}/check` | 连通性检查 + 工具发现 |
| POST | `/api/v1/mcp/servers/{id}/refresh-tools` | 强制刷新工具缓存 |
| GET | `/api/v1/mcp/servers/{id}/tools` | 工具列表（含风险/审批/启停） |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/mcp/tools/{id}` | 工具启停、审批策略（所有者） |
| GET | `/api/v1/mcp/available` | 输入框选择器用的精简目录 |

> 系统 MCP 对普通用户只返回只读工具；写/破坏性工具仅管理员可用，`GET /mcp/servers/{id}/tools` 会返回 `user_allowed=false` 供前端置灰说明。

### 2.9 技能（本地 Skill）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/skills` | 系统 + 自己的技能（含有效启停） |
| POST | `/api/v1/skills` | 手写创建（name/description/content） |
| POST | `/api/v1/skills/import` | 上传 zip 技能包（multipart） |
| GET | `/api/v1/skills/{id}` | 详情（含参考文件列表） |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/skills/{id}` | 修改自己的技能 |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/skills/{id}` | 删除自己的技能 |
| PUT | `/api/v1/skills/{id}/enabled` | 启停（系统项写用户覆盖表） |
| GET | `/api/v1/skills/{id}/files` | 参考文件列表 |
| GET | `/api/v1/skills/{id}/files/{path}` | 读取参考文件（文本） |
| GET | `/api/v1/skills/catalog` | 输入框选择器用的精简目录 |

### 2.10 长期记忆

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/memories` | 列表：`limit`、`cursor`、`kind`、`status`、`q`（有 q 走语义检索） |
| POST | `/api/v1/memories` | 手动新增 |
| GET | `/api/v1/memories/{id}` | 详情 |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/memories/{id}` | 修改内容/类型/标题/置顶/状态 |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/memories/{id}` | 物理删除 |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/memories` | 清空全部（`?confirm=true`） |
| GET | `/api/v1/memories/export` | 导出 JSON |

### 2.11 指令

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/instructions` | 生效指令、来源（user/system_default）、默认值、上限 |
| PUT | `/api/v1/instructions` | 保存用户指令；`null` 表示恢复默认 |

### 2.12 管理端

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
--- 4.6 ---
- `title` 是片段所属章节标题（解析不到时回退为文档标题）；`updated_at` 取**文档**的更新时间；
- `elapsed_ms` 为真实耗时（示例值非契约）；空库返回 `{"hits": [], "elapsed_ms": 0..}`，不是错误；
- `score = round(1 - 余弦距离, 4)`；fake embedding 模式下不应用分数阈值（词袋模型的短查询对长分块余弦上界约 0.11），真实 provider 才使用 `VECTOR_SCORE_THRESHOLD`；
- Embedding 服务不可用时返回 **503 `service_unavailable`**。

}
